implementation.termination: Fixed leaf cap or depth 32; no adaptive SAH leaf termination.
implementation.fallback: Median split with triangle-ID tie breaking when binning cannot make two nonempty sides.
implementation.triangle_storage: Original triangle/UV/normal arrays remain in their original order; only BVH index references are partitioned.

benchmark.order: Cyclic rotation of median2,median4,median8,sah2,sah4,sah8; each configuration occupies each position once.
benchmark.timing: Host render-loop clock includes GPU completion/final image readback, excludes loading/build/upload/warmup/encoding/saving. All profiling disabled.
benchmark.gpu_sampling: Before/after each run, not continuous. Ranges are min/max, not confidence intervals.
benchmark.reproduce: Copy the scene, set Camera.ITERATIONS=64 and preserve/resolve its asset paths. Run scene_render with --bvh-builder median|sah --bvh-leaf-size 2|4|8 --bvh-bins 16, six rotated rounds; no --profile or --profile-intersections.

intersection_work.population: pixelIndex % 64 == 0 among live paths before each bounce
intersection_work.note: Separate diagnostic replays. Counts are sampled, not extrapolated to all rays. The same pixel population and hits are verified across builders. Root rejections include ordinary misses and distance pruning. Instrumented wall times are excluded from speed comparisons.

median4.profile_note: Separate diagnostic run; CUDA-event stream intervals include launch gaps. Host/GPU times overlap and must not be summed. Events are resolved per sample.

sah2.profile_note: Separate diagnostic run; CUDA-event stream intervals include launch gaps. Host/GPU times overlap and must not be summed. Events are resolved per sample.

hardware_counter_limit.reason: Nsight Compute ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM: system GPU performance counters are not accessible.
hardware_counter_limit.note: No achieved occupancy or warp-stall attribution is claimed. CUDA-event timing and own traversal work counters were collected successfully.

validation.counter_oracle: Known 5-ray, 2-mesh test verifies selected-ray count, hits/misses, triangle/node/AABB counts, and distance-bound root rejection exactly.

linear_difference.note: The final PNG is byte-identical, but linear HDR/float32 are not. Tight SAH boxes expose numerical sensitivity of the existing float triangle test at very thin triangle edges. The old triangle arithmetic is preserved; no claim of full-frame bitwise linear equivalence is made.

reproduced_example.explanation: Median/float brute force accept the thin triangle. Its double-arithmetic barycentrics lie outside the triangle; the tighter SAH leaf rejects it. This is a numerical-boundary case, not changed source geometry or BSDFs.

targeted_replay.note: Reuses linked production camera/intersection/shading objects and both trees on identical selected rays. Follows median paths; captures the first intersection disagreement for each affected pixel. Double arithmetic is a diagnostic on stored float geometry, not a replacement renderer.

full_showcase.note: Final executable, no BVH override flags. One 3072-spp capture, not a repeated benchmark; compared to the previous full output. PNG identical; linear differences are reported explicitly.

provenance.note: Benchmark binary used explicit builder/leaf flags. The final build promotes the measured winner to the default. Relevant source snapshots, binaries and raw captures stay in the local archive.
